description: Calculates the 2025-2028 federal deduction for qualified tips under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (P.L. 119-21, IRC 224) as IRS Schedule 1-A Part II does: a $25,000 cap per return for every filing status, then $100 off per full $1,000 of MAGI over $150,000 ($300,000 joint). Self-employed tips count only up to that business's net income. Married filing separately gets $0. Figures copied from irs.gov in Oct 2026.

employee_tips.description: Qualified tips received as an employee (2025: Form W-2 box 7 or Form 4137; 2026+: W-2 box 12 code TP).

filing_status.description: Federal filing status. married_filing_separately cannot claim these deductions.

magi.description: Modified adjusted gross income in USD: Form 1040 line 11b plus excluded Puerto Rico and foreign income (Schedule 1-A Part I).

self_employed_net_income.description: Net income of the trade or business where the self-employed tips were earned.

self_employed_tips.description: Qualified tips received in your own trade or business (Form 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC or 1099-K).

tax_year.description: Tax year, 2025 to 2028. The deductions end after 2028.

name: calculate_tips_deduction
title: No Tax on Tips deduction
